open_spaces_details.description: Brown field land will have a change of use with the installation of 5 aggregates stock bays and 1 cement storage silo.

description: Erection of five aggregate storage bays on land adjoining the existing Capital Concrete Limited operation and the installation of one cement storage silo on land within the existing Capital Concrete Limited compound.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [CC-FELT/01 and Design and Access Statement. Received on 17/06/2022; 22-158-T-004 Rev A. Received on 15/08/2022; CC-FELT/02. Received on 18/10/2022; Noise Assessment. Received on 13/01/2023; Air Quality Assessment and Noise Assessment Response. Received on 06/03/2023].

Condition : 2 - Within three months of the date of this permission, a revised design and timetable for implementation, showing the alterations to the access and the reconstruction of the footway from the access up to the site's southern boundary, in materials and at a level to match the adjoining section of footway, shall have been submitted to and approved by Local Planning Authority. 

The approved improvement works to the access and footway shall not commence until the developer has entered into a binding agreement to secure the implementation of the approved designs. Thereafter, the approved designs shall be implemented in their entirety, in accordance with the agree timetable, and remain in place permanently.
Condition : 4 - The extension of the pedestrian barrier and alterations to the footway shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans within three months of the date of this permission.

Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the mitigation measures proposed in the approved Air Quality Assessment received on 6 March 2023, during post-construction and operational phases.

Condition : 6 - The hereby approved development must be carried out in accordance with the recommendations of the approved Noise Assessment received on 13 January 2023 and Noise Assessment Response received on 6 March 2023 and comply with the requirements of BS 4142 and 8233:2014.

Within six months of the date of this planning permission, post completion noise tests shall be carried out by accredited/approved organisations in order to demonstrate that this has been achieved. The test reports shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The measures shall be retained thereafter.

Condition : 7 - A maximum of five aggregate storage bays and one cement storage silo shall be operation on site and no process shall be carried out, including the manufacture of concrete, or maintenance of plant equipment, vehicles, equipment or deliveries taken at or dispatched from the site outside the following times: 07:00am to 7:00pm Mondays to Fridays and 07:00am to 13:00pm on Saturdays. No operations shall take place on Sundays, Public and Bank Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Within three months of this permission, a scheme of supplementary tree and shrub planting shall be submitted to and approved by the Council in writing. The approved scheme shall be implemented in full within the next planting season and any trees or shrubs that die within a period of 5 years shall be replaced with a similar species of tree or shrub.
